comparison.objective: Load a bicycle onto a bus rack and secure its wheel; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Large articulated-object lifting, channel placement, and support-arm engagement versus precision countertorque.

comparison.reason: The scaled vehicle-loading task does not test mechanical calibration.
